headline: Two new packs — Prisma AIRS and RelayShield — and an identity.* force-merge across the catalog
summary_md:
- Two packs are new: **Prisma AIRS** (36,593 insertions) and **RelayShield** (1,098), neither with any deletions.
- **Panorays** gained a triage playbook v2, **ServiceNow** took a pack enhancement that rewrote ~250 lines, and **SekoiaXDR** added commands for SOL queries.
- A force-merge adds `identity.*` to packs (CRTX-271525); 13 of the day's 25 packs moved with the same additions-and-one-deletion shape.
- Integration fixes land in Cortex XDR, EWS v2, Cisco ThousandEyes, Prisma Cloud v2 and Splunk.
- The Qualys `LAST_VM_AUTH_SCAN` default from #45681 was reverted, leaving Qualys the only pack that net shrank.

highlights.title: Prisma AIRS arrives as a new content pack
highlights.detail: At 36,593 insertions and no deletions it is over five times the size of every other pack change on the day put together.

highlights.title: RelayShield added as a new content pack
highlights.detail: 1,098 insertions with no deletions, a fresh integration rather than a rework of an existing one.

highlights.title: Cortex XDR now rejects a command delimiter in scheduled sync arguments
highlights.detail: An input-validation fix tracked as CRTX-252628, touching 88 lines of the pack.

highlights.title: Panorays gains a triage playbook v2
highlights.detail: 1,116 insertions against 47 deletions, so the new playbook is added beside the existing content rather than replacing it.

highlights.title: The Qualys LAST_VM_AUTH_SCAN default change was reverted
highlights.detail: PR #45681 was backed out, and Qualys is the only pack on the day whose deletions (72) outnumber its insertions (7).

highlights.title: ServiceNow takes a pack enhancement
highlights.detail: 351 insertions against 249 deletions under CRTX-208419 — proportionally the heaviest rewrite of an existing pack.

items.Packs/PaloAltoNetworks_Prisma_AIRs: New pack, 36,593 insertions and no deletions — the day's dominant change by an order of magnitude.
items.Packs/RelayShield: New pack added in #45742: 1,098 insertions, no deletions.
items.Packs/Panorays: Adds a triage playbook v2 (#45749); 1,116 insertions against 47 deletions.
items.Packs/SekoiaXDR: Adds commands for issuing SOL queries (#45643, re-landed as #45791); 573 insertions.
items.Packs/ServiceNow: Pack enhancement under CRTX-208419 that rewrites roughly 250 lines alongside 351 new ones.
items.Packs/CortexXDR: Scheduled sync arguments now reject a command delimiter (CRTX-252628).
items.Packs/qualys: Reverts the LAST_VM_AUTH_SCAN default introduced in #45681; the only pack that net shrank.
items.Packs/MicrosoftExchangeOnPremise: Fixes an NTLM authentication MD4 error in EWS v2 (XSUP-76118) in 9 lines.
items.Packs/CiscoThousandEyes: Fixes the fetch-events mechanism (XSUP-74825); 101 insertions, 5 deletions.
items.Packs/PrismaCloud: Prisma Cloud v2 adds a limit when fetching incidents (XSUP-75268).
items.Packs/SplunkPy: Drilldown search parsing no longer mishandles unescaped backslashes (XSUP-75731).
items.Packs/PcapAnalysis: Test fix (#45785) plus the PyPDF stderr change (XSUP-71381); 106 insertions, 74 deletions.
items.Packs/CommonScripts: 86 insertions and 41 deletions, including the ip command's handling of IPv6 addresses (#45784).
items.Packs/Netskope: 631 insertions with a single deletion, the largest of the packs carried by the identity.* force-merge shape.
items.Packs/ApiModules: 540 insertions with a single deletion, the shared modules moving with the same bulk change.
